changes.to: Dreame's own IFA 2026 press release (5 Sep 2026) names the machine ECHO P1, described as a research-stage wheeled humanoid service robot exploring tidying, organisation, object transport and safety/companion tasks in homes, restaurants, hotels, exhibition halls, schools and elder care, built on the same Omni-Perception / home-model / actuation stack as its appliance business. A companion ECHO S1 is a single-arm wheeled laundry robot. Dreame publishes no height, weight, DoF, payload, speed, runtime, battery, compute or price for the P1, so all spec fields stay empty; the record's name 'Universal Humanoid Robot' is not a Dreame product name.
Dreame Technology's household humanoid: the research-stage ECHO P1, a wheeled humanoid service robot exploring tidying, carrying and home-care tasks.
